comparison_contract.verification: independent ordered row stream and exact target column/key check after loader wall time

loaders.name: my2pg-release

identity.revision: working-tree binary digest recorded by runner

settings.verification: independent ordered row stream and exact target column/key check after loader wall time

loaders.config_template:
version = 1
[source]
url_env = "MY2PG_MYSQL_URL"
consistency = "frozen"
tls_mode = "verify_full"
ca_file = "{source_ca_file}"
[target]
url_env = "MY2PG_POSTGRES_URL"
schema = "{target_schema}"
tls_mode = "verify_full"
ca_file = "{target_ca_file}"
on_existing = "error"
[migration]
mode = "full"
table_workers = 1
readers_per_table = 1
index_workers = 1
batch_rows = 25000
batch_bytes = 16777216
queue_batches = 2
max_row_bytes = 16777216
memory_bytes = 536870912
on_row_error = "reject"
max_rejected_rows = 12500
reset_sequences = true
[tables]
include = {include_tables}
[verification]
mode = "none"
[report]
directory = "{report_dir}"
console = "json"
progress = "never"
